violated_contract: A voice that exhausted its initial allowance on noisy speech must have a bounded opportunity to recover from later proven fresh PCM without replayed windows, overlapping capture positions, forged timestamps, failed requests, or lifecycle churn creating unbounded model admission or weakening identity authority.
canonical_prevention: Use one per-admitted-voice scalar recovery ledger with physical append and capture-axis high-watermarks, ten new PCM seconds and a monotonic cooldown per grant, at most two three-attempt tranches and a hard eighteen-attempt ceiling. Reserve every recovery request synchronously through the unchanged shared socket bucket; failures spend quota. Preserve carried allowance state, checkpoint every grant, and publish recovery acceptances only through existing automatic arbitration and final authority.
